disagreements.why: The live menu_items row is the system of record; the delivery listing is a cached copy of it.
Their own page, Google listing and Instagram all carry the second i.

gaps: No press article, award or forum thread about the restaurant was found — the coverage that exists is social-video and review listings.
Venue photography in hand is real but small (nine of ten frames 300×225), so full-bleed imagery still needs a shoot or the client's originals.
No vector logo on hand: the badge is a 200×200 raster, so the wordmark is typeset rather than traced.
No booking system is evidenced anywhere in their stack; WhatsApp is the channel the site hands off to.
